Definition: a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife
BiblicalUsage: Kallah is the bride — the son's wife, the woman made perfect for her husband. Tamar waits as a widow in her father's house for the son promised to her; Isaiah says the bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments and the bride with her jewels; and God says, as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bride is the picture God chose for His love. He does not love us coldly; He rejoices over us as a bridegroom over a bride, and the marriage of the Lamb is the end toward which the whole story runs.
